_comment: One ticket's detail document, the shape src/ticket-data.js returns from the ticket:fetch IPC handler. Hand-built rather than captured so it exercises all five recognised comment prefixes; the timestamps are a real ticket's shape, shifted. Stage 3 (#1337) extends it with the comment identity a ticket pin binds to — each comment's `id`, `updatedAt` and content `revision` — and the issue's GitHub `node_id`, so a pin can detect a transfer. The lifecycle/cost/run fields this fixture used to also carry (`intervals`, `costs`, `runs`, `lifecycle_error`, `costs_error`, `runs_error`) moved to the engine's own timeline (#101/#91, fixture-ticket-timeline.json) and are no longer part of this document.
